attributes.description:
Pinchは、毎日の塩分とナトリウム摂取量をわかりやすく記録できるナトリウム管理アプリです。

1日の目標を設定し、食事を記録すると、残りのナトリウム量をミリグラムで確認できます。

毎日の塩分管理
• 朝食・昼食・夕食・間食を記録
• FatSecret提供の食品データベースを検索
• 数値がわかる食品はミリグラムでかんたん入力
• よく食べる食品を保存
• 残りの1日分をひと目で確認
• 塩分とナトリウムを換算

PINCH PLUS
FatSecret食品検索、4週間の傾向とカレンダー、無制限のカスタム食品、CSV書き出し、ホーム画面のナトリウムウィジェットを利用できます。

本アプリは日々の記録と習慣づくりを目的としており、医療上の助言を提供するものではありません。適切な目標については医療専門家にご相談ください。

attributes.description:
Pinch è un monitor del sodio e contatore giornaliero pensato per essere semplice e incoraggiante.

Imposta un budget quotidiano, registra i pasti e controlla subito quanti milligrammi ti restano.

MONITORA LA TUA GIORNATA
• Registra colazione, pranzo, cena e spuntini
• Cerca gli alimenti nel database fornito da FatSecret
• Inserisci rapidamente il sodio in milligrammi
• Salva gli alimenti che consumi più spesso
• Controlla il budget rimanente a colpo d’occhio
• Converti facilmente sale e sodio

PINCH PLUS
Sblocca la ricerca alimentare FatSecret, tendenze e calendario di quattro settimane, alimenti personalizzati illimitati, esportazione CSV e widget del sodio.

Pinch è pensato per la consapevolezza personale e le abitudini quotidiane. Non fornisce consigli medici. Chiedi a un professionista sanitario quale obiettivo di sodio è adatto a te.

Dati alimentari forniti da FatSecret.

attributes.description:
Sodium Tracker: Pinch Daily is a clear, friendly way to track sodium and keep your daily salt intake in view.

Set a sodium budget, log foods and meals, and instantly see how many milligrams remain. Pinch keeps the focus on one useful number, with gentle encouragement instead of guilt.

TRACK YOUR SODIUM
• Set a daily sodium budget
• Log breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
• Search a broad food database powered by FatSecret
• Quick-log milligrams when you already know the amount
• Save regular foods for faster daily logging
• See remaining sodium at a glance

BUILD HEALTHIER ROUTINES
• Review weekly progress and streaks
• Use gentle meal-time check-ins
• Compare usual foods with your remaining budget
• Convert between salt and sodium when needed
• Personalize your target at any time

PINCH PLUS
Upgrade for FatSecret food search and logging, four-week trends and calendar, unlimited custom foods, CSV export, and the sodium home-screen widget.

Sodium Tracker: Pinch Daily is designed for personal awareness and habit building. It does not provide medical advice. Ask a qualified healthcare professional which sodium target is right for you.

Food data powered by FatSecret.
